videos.headline: What must Keelon Russell, No. 13 Bama keep in mind ahead of Texas A&M?
videos.description: SEC Network's Matt Stinchcomb and Fozzy Whittaker discuss how Russell must show up if he wants to lead the Crimson Tide to a win against a strong Aggies defense.

videos.headline: Roman Harper stresses need for Bama to have fresh mentality vs. Texas A&M
